blocks.text: Major brands in China have dropped French football star Kylian Mbappe, saying he “hurt the feelings of the Chinese people” after a video circulated online in which he apparently joked about former leader Mao Zedong. He is the latest in a string of global athletes to have faced public backlash and financial repercussions in China after commenting on politically sensitive topics. Here are some high-profile cases: Taiwan a ‘country’ Eight-time NBA All-Star Dwight Howard referred to Taiwan as a “country” when he appeared in a video in 2023 alongside Lai Ching-te, the self-ruled island’s then-vice president and future leader. “Since I […]...
